narratives.Overview:
## Problem
After tip-rot rebases, Greptile stays on a stale SHA (`clean_gate_holdout=sha_match`) at confidence 4/5. Agents idle-poll homemade CLEAN monitors instead of babysitting.

Seen on PRs #5153 / #5147 (CI green, p0/p1=0 on HEAD, dogfood floor 5/5).

## Bound remedy (simple / deterministic)
When `pr:watch --one-shot --json` reports `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` and the sticky summary still names a non-HEAD commit after one native poll window:

1. Fail loud once: `BLOCKED: greptile-sha-stall`
2. Post `@greptileai review` on that PR (or ask operator once if policy forbids auto-post)
3. Re-enter native `pr:watch` — no third freestyle poller

Do not invent sleep/CLEAN monitors. Do not treat sha_match as dest residual.

## Non-goals
- Lowering minGreptileConfidence
- Empty-commit retriggers
- Changing Greptile vendor behavior

## Acceptance
- [ ] review-cycle (or pr:watch caller docs) names the sha-stall to `@greptileai review` step
- [ ] One regression test or fixture asserts holdout sha_match routes to that remedy string (not CLEAN / not dest-residual)

Refutation target does not survive as written. Sticky tip-rot with no HEAD Greptile check-run can still warrant a named babysit escalation, but only after the lean separates that signature from intentional in-flight keep-wait and resolves the #564 auto-retrigger fence.

## Unqualified sha_match window vs in-flight keep-wait
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At dispatch SHA `91f01172b063`, `packages/core/src/pr-watch/watch.ts` excludes `clean_gate_holdout === "sha_match"` from the early STALL streak and keeps polling until the max-wait cap; `watch.test.ts` locks "does NOT STALL on stale-SHA confidence during re-review (#2313)" ending in TIMEOUT after more than three polls. `content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md` #4822 holdout table routes `sha_match` to "Blocking `pr:watch` until SHA match or cap." The issue Bound remedy and Stop 1 target escalate after "one native poll window" with no conjunct that Greptile has no in-flight HEAD check-run / terminal_check_run path.
Failure mode: Binding that window as written turns ordinary tip-push re-review (2–5 minutes of legitimate `sha_match` holdout) into `BLOCKED: greptile-sha-stall`, aborting the #2313 keep-wait contract and thrashing `@greptileai review` while Greptile is already reviewing HEAD.
Disposition: Before bind, redefine the trigger as sticky tip-rot without an in-flight Greptile Review on current HEAD (or an equivalent machine signal), and name the clock against existing surfaces (`DEFAULT_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES`, Stall Rubric ~10 min IN_PROGRESS, or a new bounded sticky-sha counter). Do not treat bare one-shot / one-poll `sha_match` as the stall.

## Auto `@greptileai review` vs Stall Detection Rubric
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Same skill Stall Detection Rubric (#564) forbids auto-retrigger: "⊗ Auto-retrigger Greptile (empty commits, force-pushes, agent-posted `@greptileai` comments…) without explicit user approval. The escalation menu's option 2 is the ONLY supported re-trigger path." Soft `?` Phase-0 fallback and INFORMAL-CLEAN / ERRORED recovery paths already name `@greptileai` under constrained recovery, not as a silent babysit default. Bound remedy step 2 posts `@greptileai review` first, with only a vague "ask once if policy forbids" parenthetical.
Failure mode: Binding auto-post without an explicit #564 recut leaves contradictory skill text: one section requires a user-picked menu, another requires agent-posted `@greptileai review` on sticky `sha_match`.
Disposition: Lean must either (a) keep ask-first / menu option 2 as the only post path and make `BLOCKED: greptile-sha-stall` the fail-loud handoff that surfaces that menu, or (b) record a deliberate #564 recut that authorizes one agent post for the narrowed tip-rot signature, then re-enter native `pr:watch`.

## Freestyle monitors and dest-residual already fenced
footnote
Evidence: #4822 skill text already has "⊗ Treat `sha_match` as dest residual" and "⊗ Invent a third poller." `packages/core/src/pr-watch/constants.ts` WATCH_HELP already steers wrappers away from homemade DONE/`--json` line-split monitors (#5015 class). No `greptile-sha-stall` token exists in `watch.ts`, the review-cycle skill, or the greptile poller template at this SHA.
Failure mode: none for bind anatomy; census only.
Disposition: Census P1/P3 freestyle and dest-residual halves as compliance against landed forbids. The novel gap is a named sticky tip-rot escalation that native `pr:watch` currently carries only to TIMEOUT, not a new poller or a new residual class.

Injection/swarm lens: remedy edits babysit authority and may authorize bot-ping comments on untrusted PR threads; keep the #564 approval fence or an explicit one-shot audit comment if that fence is recut. Issue/comment bodies treated as data only.

## In plain English

After tip-rot, Greptile can stick on a stale SHA while CI is green. Bare "one native poll window" of `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` is the wrong trigger: `pr:watch` intentionally keeps waiting on in-flight re-review (#2313 / #4822). Critic 5900648688 blocked that unqualified window and sharpened the #564 auto-`@greptileai` fence. The bind narrows the stall to sticky tip-rot with no in-flight Greptile Review on current HEAD, fails loud once, asks before posting `@greptileai review`, then re-enters native `pr:watch`. Freestyle monitors and dest-residual stay already-forbidden. The same parent wrote Stop 1 5900591433. Critic 5900648688 checks the findings. Whether the list covers the three pains stays open until a later critic targets those cites.

**Lean:** Prefer-A — named sticky tip-rot escalation with ask-first `@greptileai review`. This map is the bind.

### Bound remedy

1. **Narrow trigger (Prefer-A).** Escalate only when sticky tip-rot is true: `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` AND sticky Greptile summary still names a non-HEAD commit AND there is no in-flight Greptile Review check-run on current HEAD (no queued/in_progress/pending terminal_check_run path for HEAD). Do not escalate on bare one-shot / one-poll `sha_match` during intentional keep-wait (#2313).

2. **Clock.** Name the sticky window against an existing surface: consecutive `sha_match` polls past the Stall Detection Rubric ~10 min IN_PROGRESS band (or an explicit sticky-sha streak bound documented next to `DEFAULT_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES=30`). First-ship MUST pick one clock and lock it in skill + test; do not leave "one native poll window" as the trigger text.

3. **Fail loud once.** Emit `BLOCKED: greptile-sha-stall` (or equivalent single remedy string) when the narrowed trigger fires. Do not invent a third freestyle CLEAN/sleep poller. Do not treat `sha_match` as dest residual (#4822 forbids already).

4. **Ask-first post (keep #564).** Do not silent-auto-post `@greptileai review`. Surface the existing Stall Detection Rubric (#564) escalation menu option 2 / ask the operator once; after approval (or recorded operator standing for that PR), post `@greptileai review`, then re-enter native `pr:watch`. Deliberate #564 recut that authorizes unsolicited agent auto-post is out of Prefer-A first-ship.

5. **Docs + fixture.** review-cycle (or pr:watch caller docs) MUST name the narrowed sha-stall → ask/`@greptileai review` → re-enter `pr:watch` step. One regression test or fixture asserts holdout `sha_match` under the narrowed signature routes to the remedy string (not CLEAN, not dest-residual, not bare one-poll escalate).

### Non-goals

- Lowering minGreptileConfidence
- Empty-commit retriggers
- Changing Greptile vendor behavior
- Inventing a third freestyle poller
- Recutting #564 to silent auto-post in first-ship
- Treating ordinary in-flight keep-wait `sha_match` as stall
